reasoning: This is a head-to-head comparison of liposomal vs free doxorubicin formulations in HER2+ breast cancer neoadjuvant therapy. The liposomal doxorubicin arm achieved 41.3% pCR vs 54.0% pCR for free doxorubicin (p=0.154). While neither arm met statistical significance, the free doxorubicin arm showed numerically superior efficacy. Both arms contained the same backbone (cyclophosphamide, trastuzumab, docetaxel), so this is primarily testing whether liposomal formulation maintains efficacy of free doxorubicin. The liposomal arm underperformed, suggesting formulation issues may have impacted drug delivery or bioavailability. No target engagement or biomarker data was reported to assess whether the liposomal formulation adequately engaged targets. Safety profiles were similar between arms.

failure_modes.evidence: Liposomal doxorubicin arm achieved lower pCR (41.3%) compared to free doxorubicin (54.0%), suggesting the liposomal formulation may have had reduced bioavailability or altered pharmacokinetics that impacted efficacy
